assertion.statement: The Karpenter 1.0.0 release notes state "Drop Env Vars for v1" — environment variables are removed in this release, but the notes do not name which variables are dropped or what happens to environments that set them.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: the release note names no specific environment variable ('Env Vars' is generic); without variable names no env-var subject identity can be spelled; applicability: the affected environment variables are not named, so no env-var/values-key/rendered predicate can be built; exposure depends on which variables an environment actually sets; consequence: the evidence does not state what happens for an environment that still sets the dropped variables (ignored, startup failure, or no effect) or whether anything replaces them
